backing: HuggingFace yahoo-finance-data dataset queried through DuckDB with cache_httpfs
caveats: it is a Yahoo mirror and inherits Yahoo's quality problems; Steps 239-240 are the precedent for auditing a vendor panel before use
no stated rate limit or update SLA
symbol-keyed, so a symbol-to-cik10 map is needed to join the SEC universe

feasibility.chosen: none yet; this is an audit and no acquisition was started
feasibility.full_pull_estimate: about 2,800 issuers x roughly 80 quarters at 1.4s each is around 87 hours of serial calls; not feasible through the per-ticker API
viable_paths: query the underlying HuggingFace dataset in bulk rather than ticker by ticker
restrict to a declared subset, for example the 500 largest issuers over the last 40 quarters, about 8 hours

transcripts.causality_anchor: report_date is supplied per transcript, so a filing-date equivalent exists
transcripts.structure: paragraph_number, speaker, content -- speaker-attributed, which allows management and analyst language to be separated
